sloka: तथोक्तो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रतिगृह्य पितुर्वचः।यज्ञभूमौ स विधिवत् पावकं जुहवेन्द्रजित् ।। ६.८०.५ ।।
transliteration: tathokto rākṣasendreṇa pratigṛhya piturvacaḥ।yajñabhūmau sa vidhivat pāvakaṁ juhavendrajit ।। 6.80.5 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the words spoken by the Lord of Rakshasas, Indrajith respecting the command poured oblations in the fireas per tradition before proceeding.
